scope: Local isolated onboarding verification; not remotely published images
websiteBuild: Fresh source archive; no preexisting node_modules or dist; frozen yarn installs and Web then Uni-App H5 builds completed. Base-image layers and pip download cache may be reused.
sourceBuildCaveat: Default Dockerfiles build from the reorganized source paths; base image tags/system repositories are not a byte-for-byte reproducibility lock. Record actual image IDs per deployment.
receiptGateFollowup: These rebuilt images include committed-receipt media gate and standalone legacy-files alias fix. Tested synthetic imports and proxy HTTP path; not production or TLS certification.
